summary: Preserve uniform dated slot states, source-matched venue pagination and successful public reads when optional cache persistence fails.
reason: Closed stock is distinct from mixed unavailability; recommendations do not exhaust matching pages and product cards do not count as venues. Response caching is optional, so storage failures must remain observable without discarding a valid live response.
validated_outcome: Domain regressions exercise full availability/discovery requests and failed persistence with live provenance; fresh publication live acceptance is required after every source edit.
